title: Sunset Lounge | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Steps From Beach Access + Private Pool- Sunset Lounge by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Sunset Lounge by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 32 Sea Walk Circle, Santa Rosa Beach, FL Details: Searching for the perfect 30A getaway? Sunset Lounge offers sweeping views of the Gulf, close proximity to the beach access, and coastal luxe interior design from Stock & Trade. This home has everything you could need for the best vacation experience on 30A. Guests of Sunset Lounge can spend long days at the beach access located just steps away, take a refreshing dip in the private pool, and end the night watching the sun set over the Gulf. Don't wait to reserve your stay at Sunset Lounge! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Located South of 30A Just 150 Feet From Back Of Home To San Juan Beach Access - *Private Heated Pool - 6-Seater LSV (Low Speed Vehicle) Included - Stunning Gulf Views - New Construction - Professional Interior Design - 2 Parking Spaces *Pool heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax) *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 14 5 Beds / 4 Full Baths / 1 Half Baths First Floor: - Bedroom 1: Queen Bed with Shared Bath (Shower) - Bonus Room / Kitchenette / Pool Deck -Laundry room Second Floor: - Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) - Bedroom 3: (Bunk Room) (2) Twin/Full Bunks, Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) Third Floor: - Kitchen / Living / Dining - Large Outdoor Deck with Stunning Views - Half Bath Fourth Floor: - Bedroom 4: (En Suite) King Bed with Private Bath (Spa Shower and Free-Standing Tub), Amazing Views - Bedroom 5: (Bunk Room) Twin/Twin Amenities Include: - 6 Adult Bikes - Beach Towel Service Please Note: *Nearby construction is underway. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
